title: Straighten horizons and verticals from the crop tool or selected photos
source: Adapted from the RapidRAW auto-straighten series through 3daf49e4
notes: Adds the crop action, Shift+S and selected-photo productivity action. Uses existing lens geometry and preserves Card/atomic/XMP paths, native repair thumbnails and crop identity. Analysis waits for loaded dimensions, drops stale photo/edit results, and keeps the open editor photo out of the batch. Existing rendered edits are unchanged.
